OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

ProtectIdentification.name: Protect Identification

TransactionContraCUSIP.name: Transaction Contra CUSIP

TransactionIdentificationOversubscriptio.name: Transaction Identification Oversubscription Quantity

TaxCategory.name: Tax Category
TaxCategory.definition: Tax category number assigned on the announcement to provide a breakdown at a category level on the inbound instruction to determine tax treatment as required by issuers, their agents, or tax authorities.
